For the Petitioner : Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, Spl. P.P.
04/Dated: 17/10/2022 The present petition has been filed for quashing of entire criminal proceeding in connection with Ratu P.S. Case No. 230/2021 lodged for the commission of alleged offences punishable under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 290, 120B of the Indian Penal Code,
section 59 of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and under section 7/20 of Cigarette & Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Ranchi.
Mr. Nilesh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that said F.I.R. has already been quashed with regard to another co-accused in W.P.(Cr.).

No. 325 of 2021 by order dated 15.07.2022 however, in para 8 of the said order it has been recorded that said F.I.R. is quashed so far as petitioner of that case is concerned and in that view of the matter, this petition has been filed.
Learned counsel for the State fairly submits that the said F.I.R. has already been quashed in the aforesaid criminal writ petition.

In view of the fact that the said F.I.R. has already been quashed with regard to another co-accused in W.P.(Cr.). No. 325 of 2021 by order dated 15.07.2022, accordingly, the said order will be treated in favour of the petitioner in connection with Ratu P.S. Case No. 230/2021, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Ranchi.
